notes.title: We Heard You... Now You Can Also Hear Each Other!
notes.content:
Since the release of Gas Station Manager, the Glyde Team has collected feedback from countless players. We’ve listened to every concern from those who were dissatisfied and worked one-on-one to resolve every issue reported.

[h3][b]We’re now much better![/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] The vast majority of bugs have been fixed, and we continue to push out new updates. 

[*] Movement has been completely reworked. There are no more staggering and visual twitching issues/ 

[*] Changes have been made to gameplay flows and balance, making everything far more optimized.

[*] We've also been working on making the single-player mode smoother and are still developing tailored solutions for it.
[/list]
For those who purchased the game solo, we’re adding new and groundbreaking features that emphasize co-op play—so even when you join random lobbies, you’ll have more opportunities to connect and have fun with other players!

[b][h3][b]WE HAVE ONE MORE SURPRISE![/b]
[/h3][/b]
For an enhanced co-op experience and better socializing, [b]our in-game voice chat [/b] and [b] text to speech chat [/b] is live!

Now you can communicate with your friends (or even new ones you make!) directly from within the game.

[h3][b]Our roadmap for the future is also set.[/b]
[/h3]

We’ve taken note of every detail, and entirely new features are on the way to transform Gas Station Manager into an even better experience!

Best,
Glyde Team

notes.title: 🚨 UPDATE v0.3.2 – Now With More Smack! 🚨
notes.content:
🚨 UPDATE v0.3.2 – Now With More Smack! 🚨

Hey there, chaotic clerks! We’re back with another update, and this one brings justice—or at least a way to deal with those annoying customers who dare to question your gas station’s superior service.

✨ New Stuff
🦇 You can now hit customers anytime you want!
That’s right. No more waiting for them to misbehave—you’re now free to express your… frustrations. But be warned: some customers don’t appreciate a good bonk and might just storm off. Choose your swings wisely!

🛠 Fixes & Improvements
✅ The legendary "Can I get…" bug is finally fixed! 🙏
You’ll never have to endure the endless agony of customers staring at you mid-sentence again. We did it. We survived.
✅ A whole bunch of critical bug fixes—because we’d rather you crash the economy, not the game.
✅ Optimization improvements to make everything smoother, faster, and slightly less on fire.

That’s it for now! Keep the fuel flowing, the shelves stocked, and the bats… well, use responsibly. See you at the pumps! 🚗💨

notes.title: Full Launch on March 18th!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce that the full version of Gas Station Manager will officially launch on March 18th! 

So... Get ready to experience the [b]complete[/b], [b]chaotic[/b], and[b] fun-filled[/b] world of managing your very own gas station!

[h2][b]What’s New in the Full Launch?[/b][/h2]

[h3]Expanded Gameplay:[/h3] Enjoy [b]new challenges[/b], [b]enhanced co-op features[/b], and even more ways to run your station like a pro.

[h3]Enhanced Features: [/h3]We’ve [b]fine-tuned the mechanics[/b] and added [b]fresh content [/b]based on your invaluable feedback from the demo.

[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/h3] Thanks to your reports and suggestions, we’ve squashed bugs and optimized the game for a smoother experience.


[h3][b]We Need You![/b][/h3]
Your feedback has been a huge part of our journey so far. As you dive into the full version on launch day, keep sharing your favorite moments, any issues you encounter, or ideas for improvements on the Steam forums and our Discord.

[h3][b]Join The Community[/b]
[/h3]Don’t forget to connect with fellow managers on Discord to swap tips, share hilarious mishaps, and celebrate your victories!

[h3][b][url=https://discord.gg/qaX7krfwTC]Gas Station Manager Discord[/url]
[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Stay Updated
[/b][/h3]Make sure you’re following us on Steam and social media so you never miss an update. Every wishlist and follow helps us make Gas Station Manager even better!

We can’t wait to see you all in action, managing your stations and taking the chaos to the next level. [b]Mark your calendars for March 18th[/b]—let’s make this the most unforgettable gas station experience ever!

Best,
[b]Glyde Games Team[/b]

notes.title: GSM Coming in Hot!
notes.content:
Hey Everybody!

It has been a crazy week for GSM. The steam page is now finally live! 
Meanwhile, we've been busy working on the playable version of the demo non-stop to have a better gameplay experience.

We have mainly focused on:
[list]
[*] Creating the Steam lobby system to play with your friends
[*] re-working the gas pumping mechanic
[*] Fixing game-breaking bugs for multiplayer
[*] The main menu :)
[/list]

Stay tuned for the demo release date. We're on schedule for that and soon will be announcing it.
